source.stringEncoding: windows-1252 (the five undefined bytes would map to U+0081.. like MultiByteToWideChar)
source.bitmaps: bmp/<id>.bmp = 14-byte BITMAPFILEHEADER + the RT_BITMAP resource bytes of the EXE (verified against the EXE)
source.spec: the 5.4 built-in bulb table: 49 records of 0x3C8 bytes
source.generator: reference tools of the Holiday Lights 5.4 analysis (not part of this repository)

conventions.order: bulbs[] is in table order (= 5.4 creation order = Settings bulb-list order); 'id' is the legacy bulb id stored in the registry 'Bulb Settings' (NOT the table index)
conventions.slug: stable string id is 'builtin:' + slug (slug = the name in lower case without apostrophes, every run of other characters than a-z and 0-9 replaced by '-', trimmed of '-')
conventions.cells: cell numbers are 1-based indices into the rows (5.4 CellIndexToRect); 0 = unused slot
conventions.rows: rows[0..3] = normal art, stacked from y = 0, x restarts at 0 in every row; rows[4..7] = 1/4-size art used only in the screen-saver preview mode, offset by smallOffset
conventions.edgeCells: edgeCells[side][flavor][frame], side order top, right, bottom, left (slots 0..3); lookup uses flavor % flavorCount and frame % phaseCount
conventions.cornerCells: cornerCells[corner][frame], corner order topLeft, topRight, bottomRight, bottomLeft (slots 4..7); lookup uses frame % phaseCount
conventions.spacing: hSpacing applies to top/bottom strips and corners, vSpacing to left/right strips (added before AND after the cell)
conventions.mask: 1 bpp, colour table {0: white, 1: black}; black (bit set) = opaque, white = transparent
conventions.categories: categoriesRaw split on '|', tokens space-trimmed, empty tokens dropped
conventions.recordBytes: every byte of each 0x3C8 record is represented (pad byte +0x05 is always 0; strings are NUL-terminated and zero-padded); re-encoding a record reproduces the EXE bytes
